description:
Calculate import customs payments into Russia for one goods item, in RUB.

    Computes: import duty by the EAEU ETT rate (ad valorem, specific per kg/pcs/pair/litre,
    or combined 'X%, but not less than Y EUR per unit'), antidumping duty, excise, import VAT
    ((customs value + duty + antidumping + excise) x 22% or 10%) and the 2026 customs clearance
    fee by customs value bracket. Converts currencies at Bank of Russia rates.
    Returns a line-by-line breakdown with sources.

antidumping_rate_pct.description: Antidumping/countervailing/special duty rate in % of customs value, if a measure applies
antidumping_rate_pct.title: Antidumping Rate Pct

code.description: TN VED EAEU code; its ETT duty rate is used if duty_rate is not given
code.title: Code

currency.description: Currency of customs_value: RUB, CNY, USD, EUR, etc.
currency.title: Currency

customs_value.description: Customs value of the goods (usually CIF to the EAEU border) in `currency`
customs_value.title: Customs Value

duty_rate.description: Duty rate as in the tariff, overrides the code: '10', '0', '0,6 евро за 1 кг', '15, но не менее 2,5 евро за 1 пару'
duty_rate.title: Duty Rate

exchange_rates.description: RUB per 1 unit, e.g. {'CNY': 11.2, 'EUR': 92.5}. If omitted, Bank of Russia rates for `on_date` are fetched
exchange_rates.title: Exchange Rates

excise_rub.description: Excise in RUB if the goods are excisable (alcohol, tobacco, fuel, cars)
excise_rub.title: Excise Rub

on_date.description: Declaration date YYYY-MM-DD for exchange rates; default today
on_date.title: On Date

quantity_kg.description: Net weight in kg, needed for per-kg specific rates
quantity_kg.title: Quantity Kg

recycling_fee_rub.description: Car recycling fee (утильсбор) in RUB from calc_recycling_fee, to show the full cost of importing a vehicle. Not part of the VAT base
recycling_fee_rub.title: Recycling Fee Rub

vat_rate.description: Import VAT rate in 2026: 22 general, 10 for goods on Government lists (some food, children's goods, medical), 0 if exempt
vat_rate.title: Vat Rate

name: calc_import_payments
